summary: Tested the Safety Gate correction (auto_red removed, only a named professional sets limits, admin auto-restricted count), the restored legacy Safety Assessment, the hidden Safety Gate UI, and the case_id Family check-in link. Backend: the main agent's 5 in-process suites pass (38 passed). A new public-URL suite also passes (11/11). Frontend: everything requested works except one item. A new parent who taps Self Journey or Court Ordered on the portal landing is NOT shown the legacy SafetyScreen modal. They go straight in.

minor.issue: Creates iter144_*@example.com users and never deletes them. About 98 had piled up; I deleted them along with my own test_iter149 users.

ui_bugs.issue: A brand-new parent with no safetyAck taps Self Journey or Court Ordered and enters directly. modal-safety-screen never opens. JourneyShell.openDoor() just calls setView and skips SacoparentsPortal.requestDoorEntry. git history shows openDoor was the same before 2026-10-16. Back then the only SafetyScreen entry inside Self Journey was the 'Conflict Readiness' module (moduleCta -> onOpenSafety -> setSafetyOpen). That module was removed with A/B/C in commit 14e6a00 and not restored. Today the modal only opens from IntroChatBot, GuideFollowupModal and onStartAssessment('court').

passed_checks: GET /api/admin/safety-audit-log/auto-restricted: admin gets exactly {count:1} with no-store; a parent gets 403; no login gets 401/403
POST /api/internal/safety-status returns 503 {detail:'Unavailable.'} for empty, bad-JSON and auto_red bodies (secret confirmed unset; I did not print or set it)

New linked case (2 fresh parents): /api/case-settings gives free_form_messaging true and banner null for both; /api/family-checkin/link gives the same SA- case_id to both, with no align_ref and no-store; unlinked parent gets {case_id:null}; no login gets 401

Legacy assessment: questions 200 (28+8), incomplete submit 400, submit 200 with result.level int, /me returns it, PDF starts with %PDF, one-pager and court-report 200 application/pdf, another user's PDF 403/404
Invite gate: no screen -> safety_screen_required; level 1/2 -> blocked; level 3/4 -> clear; POST /invites/coparent 403 with no screen

UI: linkdemo A and B, Self and Court check-in href = https://sacoparentsalign.com/check-in?case=SA-TLINKDEF0, target=_blank, status 'Not finished yet'; fresh unlinked parent href = https://sacoparentsalign.com; no safety-screening or align_ref hrefs
UI: /case-settings and /plan-options redirect to '/'; no case-settings banner and no 'View options' card on the portal
UI: /safety shows safety-take-assessment-cta; /safety-assessment intro -> 28 + 8 questions -> results 'Assisted Problem-Solving' (Level 3) -> PDF download works
UI admin /admin/audit-log: 'Cases restricted automatically: 1'; Align status panel (webhook off, auto_red_refused and no_professional_name reasons) and daily counts table render

Regression: nav-get-help goes to /help; /situation has 'Get Help' and no 'safety' wording; A/B/C chats are not visible; no horizontal overflow at 390px on /, Self Journey, /safety-assessment and /admin/audit-log

Either route JourneyShell door-self/door-court (and door-switch) through requestDoorEntry when !safetyAck (pass an onRequestDoor prop that opens SafetyScreen and then calls openDoor on clear/continue), or restore the pre-14e6a00 'Conflict Readiness' entry (onOpenSafety). Confirm with the user which one matches 'exactly as before'.
Minor: make test_iter144_safety_gate_on_invites.py delete the users it creates
critical_code_review_comments: case_safety.count_auto_restricted counts only safety_mode=='restricted' with set_by=='auto_red'. Any old auto_red record with mode 'structured' is limited but not counted. Check that this is intended.
count_auto_restricted decrypts every case_safety doc on each admin page load. Fine at today's size, but O(n) Fernet work.
handle_signed refuses auto_red and unnamed-professional updates before the replay record is stored. Align retrying the same body is logged as a refusal again rather than as a 'replay'. Acceptable.
useCheckinLink CODE_RE only accepts ^SA-[A-Z0-9]{4,32}$. Cases with other codes (e.g. PAIR-DEMO-01) silently fall back to the main Align site.
Portal safetyAck lives in localStorage (SAFETY_ACK_KEY) and is synced from the server. Clearing storage or switching device may re-prompt or drop the flag, depending on the server sync.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (SafetyScreen gate on the door buttons missing)
